Paper Name: Novel optimization technique of isolated microgrid with hydrogen energy storage
NOTES: Paper focuses on operational optimization (dispatch), not system sizing. Most economic, cost, lifetime, and O&M parameters not reported. Uses IEEE 15-bus modified test system. Three configurations studied; Configuration 3 (hybrid with hydrogen storage) used as primary. Peak load 3.5 MW, base load 2500 kW, power factor 0.7 reported but not as total annual load. Diesel fuel cost coefficients (a, b, c) referenced from [21] but numeric values not given. H2 storage system efficiency cited as 30% from literature [11], not this paper's direct value. Wind turbine model: Polaris 100kW — no cut-in/rated wind speeds reported. Fuel cell/electrolyzer given as arrays, not discrete unit counts. Cost results in Table 5 are optimization outcomes ($/day), not cost parameters.
